scope: Post-evaluation diagnostic only, no fit or candidate promotion.
inputs: The completed fixed tau2/6/12 experiments; frozen origin-trend and observed-target-cluster labels from diagnostico-eventos-proxy-carreiro-20260921.
membership: Join exact origin,target_time,nominal_lead_h; verify targets, anchors and baseline predictions unchanged. Do not recalculate or select event boundaries from forecast errors. Preserve unknown trend and missing/unassigned high targets.
metrics: Every horizon1..12 and both model families: count scheduled rows, observed targets, forecast failures, pairs, hits within0.50m, MAE,bias,P98,max. Report each fixed observed high-target cluster and each origin trend for all/high targets. Compare scenarios on the same paired samples and assert unchanged coverage.
event_weighting: For each horizon/family/scenario, additionally report arithmetic mean of per-cluster MAE and hit fraction, giving each represented cluster equal weight. This describes sensitivity to pooled sample dominance, not an estimate of prospective accuracy or independence.
constraints: Previously inspected development data; observed target>=7m is an outcome-based evaluation subset, never a runtime selector. Origin trend uses only pre-origin endpoints but is diagnostic here. No best tau chosen by horizon, event or trend; no dynamic switching implemented.
